tagline: Developing life science reagents, instruments and services for research, diagnostics and bioprocessing
hero_kpi_rationale: The Protein Sciences segment represents approximately 71% of total revenue and is the company's primary driver of organic growth, with strong commercial execution and momentum in proteomics analytical solutions.

kpis.name: Protein Sciences Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of high-quality biological reagents and proteomics analytical tools.
kpis.description: The segment represents the bulk of the company's revenue and displays sustained growth despite general headwinds.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth of 5% driven by proteomics analytical solutions and cell therapy.

kpis.name: Diagnostics and Spatial Biology Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from diagnostic products, molecular tests and tissue analysis instruments.
kpis.description: Fast-growing segment following the Lunaphore acquisition in 2024, with positive momentum in spatial solutions.
kpis.signal: Organic growth of 6% driven by molecular diagnostics and Lunaphore expansion.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deduction of direct production costs.
kpis.description: Adjusted gross margin is more stable at 70.4%, demonstrating the underlying quality of the business model.
kpis.signal: Slight decline due to premium reintegration and product mix deterioration.

kpis.name: Adjusted Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin excluding non-recurring items such as amortization of intangible assets or restructuring costs.
kpis.description: More relevant metric for comparing baseline operating performance, excluding acquisition and restructuring impacts.
kpis.signal: High underlying margin despite slight pressure.

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding acquisition effects and foreign exchange variations.
kpis.description: Growth is driven by strong commercial execution in both segments.
kpis.signal: Acceleration of organic growth to 5% in 2025 following a slowdown in 2024.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Earnings Growth
kpis.explanation: Net income growth excluding non-recurring charges and gains.
kpis.description: Underlying operating performance improves through volume leverage in Protein Sciences.
kpis.signal: Growth of 8% from 2024 to 2025 driven by volume leverage in Protein Sciences.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years declared by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.08 $ last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years declared.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.05B $ last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 68.7% last year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 fiscal years 10-K filed.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated net income on an annual basis, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filed.

kpis.name: Lunaphore Acquisition Impact
kpis.explanation: Contribution of the Lunaphore acquisition to Diagnostics segment growth in 2024.
kpis.description: Lunaphore strengthened spatial biology offerings and contributed to segment growth in 2024-2025 with 6% organic growth in Diagnostics.
kpis.signal: Key acquisition completed in 2024 for 169.7M $ that strengthens spatial biology offerings.

kpis.name: Wilson Wolf Investment
kpis.explanation: 19.9% stake acquired in 2023 with option to acquire remainder by 2027.
kpis.description: Strategic investment in an innovative bioprocessing company, aligned with future growth. The company will acquire the remaining shares by end of 2027.
kpis.signal: Progressive acquisition strategy to strengthen cell therapy and bioprocessing.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity risks, including data breaches and attacks on its information systems. The language used is intense and the company's current context, involving sensitive data, reinforces this concern.

risks.title: Regulatory
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in life sciences and health. Regulatory changes could impact its operations.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The life sciences market is highly competitive. The company must maintain its position against established players and new entrants.

risks.title: Technology Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on technology for its operations. Technology failures could impact its business.

risks.title: Data Management
risks.score_rationale: The company manages sensitive data. Loss or breach of this data could have serious consequences.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning or AI tools in Bio-Techne's products, services or operational processes in the provided documents.
evidence: No reference to AI in Protein Sciences or Diagnostics segments
No mention of AI APIs, AI-enabled features in instruments, or customer adoption
Growth strategy focused on acquisitions and commercial execution, not digital innovation
